title: fix(progress): best scores lost after an Android 15 OS update, on 1.0.0
body:
**Size:** S
**Affects:** 1.0.0 on Android (Play closed test).

After an OS update to Android 15 QPR2, AsyncStorage comes back empty and best scores are gone. It is fixed upstream in `@react-native-async-storage/async-storage` 2.2.1; 1.0.0 ships 2.2.0.

**Release route:** the owner wants this on the live 1.0.0, on `release/1.0.0`.

### Work

- [ ] Upgrade `@react-native-async-storage/async-storage` to 2.2.1
- [ ] Check `stores/progress.ts` still reads old data

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Best scores survive the OS update on a Pixel
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
why: A shipped-version fix that needs a native package upgrade, which moves the fingerprint and cannot land on the locked release/1.0.0.
